sourceNote: The third Tripo P2 cat mesh with its quads (assets/models/cat/README.md). The hand rig assets/models/cat/tripo-hand/cat.blend starts from it in headless Blender with the calls of tools/blender/studio_armature.py (design 4.4, "Hand rig").
name: Cat

studio.trunkNote: The trunk of the seated bind sits upright (trunk_turn() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py), as seated string players sit tall. The pelvis turns back until the hip angle opens by open degrees, and each trunk bone takes its share.
studio.bindArmsNote: With straightArms, bindArms.upper_arm sets the bind upper arm, and bindArms.forearm sets only the elbow axis: the cross product of the bind upper arm and this forearm direction (StudioBody.hinges, bind_hinges() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py). The two directions are the directions of the old bent bind of the bent bind of the violin hold, so that the elbow axes and the zero of the roll of the upper arm stay. The paw has no bind direction, because it keeps the turn of the upper arm.
studio.straightArmsNote: The bind keeps the arms of the source straight: the forearm and the paw keep the turn of the upper arm, so that the rest shape holds the bend of no role, and each hold bends the elbow and the wrist from the same shape (the role-neutral bind of design 4.4).
studio.bindSupinationNote: The bind paws take no supination (paw_supination() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py), so the bind forearms have no twist. On the Tripo rabbit, a bind supination twisted the bind forearm, and the crease angle then showed the diagonals of its quads (assets/models/rabbit/README.md, "Arm twist").
studio.note: legTurns gives the world turn of each left leg bone from the seated bind to the source: the thigh slopes 20 degrees down and 8 degrees out, and the shin leans 12 degrees forward of vertical, so that most of the thigh lies on the seat (uv run --no-project --with numpy python -I tools/rig/leg_turns.py <config> 20 8 12).
studio.tailBindNote: The direction of each tail bone in the seated bind (bind_turns() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py): the root goes down and back, and the tip forward along the left side of the haunch. The key bind_tail of tripo-hand/cat.blend lays the tail tube on the seat around the left side of the haunch, as the tail of the cat of main curls on the seat (assets/models/cat/README.md, "Tail on the seat").

tone.note: No move. The hand route does not read the tone. The color map of the source replaces the face colors in the app.

colors.note: Each face takes the mean sRGB color of the texture at a grid of samples. A face is dark when at least eyeShare of its samples are below dark. A dark face in the eye box is an eye, and a face in the nose box near the nose color is the nose. A palette of palette colors (k-means in Oklab) keeps the colors few.
colors.eyeBoxNote: The eye box holds the two loose eyeballs of the source (x -0.016 to 0.084 on the left, y 0.743 to 0.839, z 0.109 to 0.203 in the source, mapped by the point edits). The nose box holds the pink nose.

eyeShell.note: Each eye shell is a fan from the middle of the dark faces of the eye to at most points points of their edge, lifted along the normal of the eye. pnpm studio-body drops the fan, and the app puts its pea eye there (design 4.5). The faces of the old eye take the main color of the ring around it.

chair.note: The seat is level, and its top is the lowest point of the seated body over the seat, with no shin, foot, or tail (seat_masks() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py). The front edge lies seatGap units behind the knee joint of the bind (the property seat of the armature), so that the calf does not reach over the seat.

armSegments.note: Each upper arm and each forearm has 4 deform segments, and each elbow and wrist a helper bone of this length in units, as on the other bodies.

jointsNote: The places are the places of the source, mapped by the point edits of the hand rig (assets/models/cat/README.md: the paw turns, the head width, the paw size, the arm girth, the shin girth, and the longer shins). The source places are in the studio units and axes of the source pose: 1 unit from the soles to the ear tips, the soles at y = 0, +z forward, +x the left side. The right side mirrors the left side. The FBX has no armature, so each joint comes from cuts of the mesh and from its edge loops: the arm axis at y 0.60 (x 0.085 to 0.39), the narrowest arm cut at x 0.29 (the wrist), the narrowest leg cut at y 0.13 under the knee, and the tail from the root at y 0.36.
bodyNote: The facts of the body (BODY_FACTS of tools/studio-body.ts) beside the height: the crease angle 55, because the arm loops of the source have 8 vertices, 45 degrees apart, and the seat width 0.46 m of the cat of main.
eyeSizeNote: The head height H of the body in units, as studio-body measures it on the export, before the head size. The hand rig keeps the eyes of the mesh, so it places no pea eye.
metersPerUnitNote: The scale of the app: H (0.237777 units) is 0.339355 m, near the H of the cat of assets/models/cat/cat.rig.glb (0.339375 m).
chairNote: The seat of the rig in units of this body, as the property seat of the armature of tripo-hand/cat.blend holds it.
rollSplitNote: The simple route splits the roll segments by place (roll_split() of tools/blender/simple_rig.py). The hand rig sets the same split in the exact rows of each arm ring (assets/models/cat/README.md, "tripo-hand/cat.blend").
